s1.syndrome_frame: Tachyarrhythmia with abnormal cardiac structure and function
salient_findings: Fast heart rate with wide QRS complex tachycardia
Elevated Troponin T and N-terminal pro-brain-type natriuretic peptide
key_facts: Patient in their 30s
No previous medical or family history
No chest pain, shortness of breath, vertigo, or dizziness
Vital signs: Temperature 36.8°C, Blood pressure 102/57 mm Hg, Pulse rate 170 beats/min, Respiratory rate 20 breaths/min
Normal physical examination except for fast heart rate
Troponin T: 0.018 ng/mL
N-terminal pro-brain-type natriuretic peptide: 1709 pg/mL
Mild enlarged left atrium with diameter of 34 mm
Normal left ventricle with end-diastolic diameter of 46 mm and ejection fraction of 72%
ECG findings: Wide QRS complex tachycardia, dissociated P waves, and left-axis deviation
Genetic testing identified LMNA gene variant (p.Arg377Cys)

differentials: Mitochondrial myopathy, encephalopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes
per_call: Mitochondrial myopathy, encephalopathy, lactic acidosis, and stroke-like episodes

shortlist.label: Atrial fibrillation
shortlist.why_kept: ECG findings of atrial fibrillation with ventricular rate of 46 beats/min

shortlist.label: Arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Wide QRS complex tachycardia and abnormal cardiac structure

shortlist.label: Progressive cardiac conduction defect
shortlist.why_kept: Third-degree atrioventricular block with ventricular rate of 48 beats/min

shortlist.label: Restrictive cardiomyopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Mild enlarged left atrium and abnormal natriuretic peptide levels

raw.rationale: The presence of a LMNA gene variant (p.Arg377Cys) and the combination of cardiac conduction defects (third-degree atrioventricular block, wide QRS complex tachycardia) along with mild left atrial enlargement and elevated N-terminal pro-brain-type natriuretic peptide levels are consistent with Lamin A/C cardiomyopathy.

rejected.label: Atrial fibrillation
rejected.why: Atrial fibrillation is noted in the ECG findings but it is not the primary diagnosis as it does not explain the genetic findings or the wide range of cardiac conduction defects

rejected.label: Arrhythmogenic left ventricular cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: The left ventricle is described as normal with a preserved ejection fraction, which does not support this diagnosis

rejected.label: Progressive cardiac conduction defect
rejected.why: While conduction defects are present, this diagnosis does not account for the structural changes (mild left atrial enlargement) or the genetic findings

rejected.label: Restrictive cardiomyopathy
rejected.why: There is no evidence of restrictive filling pattern or significant left ventricular dysfunction to support this diagnosis
